info.title: Corporate Account Information
info.description:
Corporate Accounts API allow clients to:
 * Retrieve list of accounts(DDA, credit card, trust, and loan accounts)
 * Retrieve DDA Account balances for current-day and previous-day
 * Retrieve DDA Transactions for current-day and previous-day
 * Retrieve Transactions data for credit cards
 * Retrieve Transactions data for loan cards
 * Retrieve Statements of corporate deposit and creditcards accounts.
 * Credit card  Statements size greater than two MB are not be supported via this API.
 * Support async workflow for generating a given statement.
 * Support for new optional WIRES attribues within current and previous-day transactions endpoints; these new attributes adhere to ISO 20022 reporting standards.
 *  Support corporate data sharing use case where SaaS providers can access corporate data on behalf of a U.S. Bank customer using the 3-legged OAuth 2.0 solution (i.e., Authorization Code grant type).
 *  Supports the ability to fetch good funds balance for a DDA account. The good funds balance reflects balance adjusted by any real-time transactions including current day hard and memo (credit and debit) transactions.
 
## Version History
- **2.1**: Added support for statements endpoint
- **2.2**: Added reporting capability for credit cards account type       
- **2.3**: Adding new async '/accounts/statements/requests' and '/accounts/statements/requests/{requestID}' endpoints and support for new optional attributes (within current and previous-day transactions endpoints) that adhere to ISO 20022 standards for all wire transactions. These new optional attributes are usBankCharges, creditorReference,creditor, creditorAgent, ultimateCreditor, purposeOfPayment, remittanceInformation, completedDate, SendersReference, intemediaryAgent1, intemediaryAgent2, intemediaryAgent3, debtor, ultimateDebtor, debtorAgent, instructionForCreditorAgent, instructingAgent, approvedBy, and extendedRemitanceInfo.
- **2.4**: Adding support for corporate data sharing use case where SaaS providers can access corporate data on behalf of a U.S. Bank customer using the using the 3-legged OAuth 2.0 solution (on-behalf-of request header is ignored; instead Client-ID request is a mandatory attribute for the corporate data sharing use case)
- **2.5**: Adding new account balance endpoint that returns the good funds balance account for a given DDA account (1 account at a time), adding support for ACH Returns and NOC endpoints for current and previous day, and adding support for loan accounts to the API

get.summary: Get list of accounts for the authorized customer.
get.description:
* Get list of accounts for the authorized customer
* Use pageNumber and pageSize for filtering

* Maximum pageSize limit is 500

post.summary: Get account balances for an array of accounts for previous-day.
post.description:
* Get account balances for an array of accounts for previous-day
* Account balances for 50 accounts can be retrieved at a time
* Default pageNumber = 1 , pageSize = 50
* Only 1 day's worth of transactions (using date query string parameter) can be retrieved per call. You can go back and fetch data depending on the retention policy (4,12, or 24 months) enabled on your account; however, you are limited to retrieve transactions for one date within that retention period.
* If accountID or accountNumber are not provided as part of the request body, then a paginated response of all accounts will be provided
* Retreival of historic balances information depends on retension period set on each account. 
* A search can go up to previous 4 months from the day of API call.
* If the retension period is greater than 4 months(found on the account list call) respective startdate and enddates can pull balances accordingly.

get.summary: Get good funds balance for one demand deposit account.
get.description: * Get good funds balance for one demand deposit account (DDA). Returns memo credits, debits, and good funds balance (this balance is dynamically updated throughout the day to reflect both hard-posted and memo-posted transactions as they occur against your account). This endpoint is protected through a fine-grained entitlement; please reach out to the sales team

get.summary: Get transactions of an account for prior business days over a date range.
get.description:
* Get transactions of an account for prior business days over a date range
* If date is not provided then date will default to the previous business day
* If limit is not provided in the request, by default 100 transactions will be returned
* Up to 2 years worth of transactions can be retrieved if entitled(this is optional)
* Default pageNumber =1 and pageSize = 100
* Maximum "limit" is 500
* Transaction retreival depends on retention period set on the account, retention period can be found on the GET accounts call.

get.summary: Get transactions of a credit card account over a date range.
get.description:
* Get transactions of an account over a date range
* If startDate and endDate are not provided then both startDate and endDate will default to the previous business day
* If only startDate is provided then endDate will default to startDate for the range
* When endDate is provided then startDate is required.
* If limit is not provided in the request, by default 100 transactions will be returned
* 60 days worth of transactions can be retrieved per call which can be upto 2 years back in time.
* Default pageNumber =1 and pageSize = 100
* Maximum "limit" is 500

code.description:
Long term persistent identifier which can be used to trace error condition back to log information. 
  format: AAA.BBBB.CCCC 
    * AAA = 3-Digit HTTP Status Code
    * BBBB = 4-Digit Apigee Proxy API ID. Assigned by EASE. 
    * CCCC = 4-Digit Error Reason Code. Assigned by LOB API Development Team
    Codes returned externally may differ from the codes produced within US Bank by internal facing API.  
    
|AAA|BBBB|CCCC|message|attributeName|reason|
|:--|:---|:---|:---|:---|:---|
|500|||Subsystem unavailable|
|404|||Account not found |
|404|||Document not found|
|400|||Invalid start or end date|
|400|||Invalid date range|
|400|||Account ID is required|
|400|||Account ID is not in correct format|
|400|||Transaction Not Found|
|400|||Account is not enrolled in e-statements|
|400|||No Documents available for this account|
|400|||Statement ID is required|
|400|||Invalid offset/limit, page does not exist|

bankReferenceNumber.description: This attribute is a bank system generated unique transaction ID for each transaction. It refer's to the following types of transactions </br> 1. For RTP transactions, bankReferenceNumber is the unique transaction identifier submitted by the customer at the time of making request. This is also the last 7 digits of the unique transactions for previous-day reporting </br> 2. For BookTransfers transaction, bankReferenceNumber is the unique transaction identifier </br> 3. For checkDeposits/CheckPaid/Cont Disb Checks/Outgoing cash Letter, bankReferenceNumber is the unique transaction identifier.  </br> 4. For ACH transactions, bankReferenceNumber refers to the PAR Number provided by the ACH network </br> 5. For Zelle transactions, bankReferenceNumber refers to the  zellePaymentID </br> 6. For wire transactions, bankReferenceNumber refers to the PAR Number provided by the fed/swift network
